heading: Experience
subheading: Internships where I worked on charging software and the services behind it.

entries.description: Engineered a Spring Boot backend for EV charging infrastructure including protocols, integrating mulitple Charging Software Management Systems (CSMS) to control and monitor 50+ real and virtual chargers; built a real-time admin dashboard providing live network and station status visibility across the entire fleet.

Worked on EV-SIM, a full-stack OCPP 2.0.1 simulation platform. Implemented the FastAPI backend and a Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind interface, including OpenAI API integration so chargers could be controlled in natural language.
